title: Arrived Broken
text: Arrived Broken. I was very excited to get this squirrel table. However, it arrived broken. The table top was split in half. My husband used wood glue and was able to fix it. There is an end piece that is included and requires you to attach it with screws that are included. We have it outside and have positioned a camera on it so we can see any visitors. So far, none have checked it out, but we just put it up last night.
